_comment: Shared TypeScript configuration for every Maxpromo application.
Applications extend this and add only what is genuinely app-specific:
their own `paths` and `include`. Before this file each repository kept
its own copy and the two had already drifted on target, lib and strictness.
allowImportingTsExtensions: relative imports inside packages/* carry the
.ts extension so Node can load those files directly. The audit tooling
imports the Domain and Brand registries as modules rather than re-parsing
them, and a check that reads its own second reading of the source is
checking its parser. Valid only with noEmit, which every workspace uses.
